beats.say: 73 goals: Harry Kane just banked a staggering club and country tally this season, the BBC reveals.
BBC notes the ceremony has been held at Paris' Theatre du Chatelet since 2019.
Yet the BBC confirms the 2026 ceremony moves to London's Palladium Theatre on Monday 26 October.
BBC adds France Football has run the award since 1956, and the 2024 winner has had injury-hit seasons.
Harry Kane arrives with 73 goals across club and country this season, a staggering tally, BBC reveals.

meta.title: Harry Kane scores 73 goals before Ballon d'Or ⚽
meta.alt_title: Ballon d'Or moves to London on 26 October 🏆
meta.summary: England captain Harry Kane heads into the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony at London's Palladium Theatre after scoring 73 goals across club and international matches in 2025-26.
meta.comment: Is Harry Kane's 73 goals enough to win the Ballon d'Or, or who beats him?
sources: BBC, All you need to know about the 2026 Ballon d'Or, 2026-10-23
facts: England captain Kane scored 73 goals across club and international competitions in the 2025-26 season.
The ceremony has been held at Paris' Theatre du Chatelet since 2019.
The 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony moves to London's Palladium Theatre on Monday 26 October.
France Football has run the award since 1956.
The 2024 Ballon d'Or winner has had consecutive seasons marred by injury.
